name: Leju Robotics
summary: Leju Robotics is a Shenzhen humanoid maker founded in 2016 that started with small educational bipeds and now sells the full-size Kuavo series. It has applied for a ChiNext listing on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange.
funding: Raised about 1.5 billion yuan (about $200 million) in October 2025 (The Robot Report); earlier backers include Tencent and Shenzhen Capital Group (Wikipedia).
